_comment: SIGNAL 45 slice incident families (six, D-043). Slice subset of the 19 §3 schema — carries family/trigger/warning/severity/pause_tier/escalation_phases/cascade/responses/aftermath; the full schema's remaining fields (cause, location, affected rooms/residents, works generated, materials/equipment, interactions, recovery, delayed consequences, completion/failure, save behavior, test scenario) are the incident-implementation stage's named deliverable (D-045). Values PROVISIONAL. The scheduler caps stand: 1 major immediate crisis, <=2 minor warnings, queueing for the rest.

flywheel_instability.trigger: load spike or bearing wear (event 1 chain)
flywheel_instability.warning: bearing whine + browning lamps (banner), 1 day lead
flywheel_instability.aftermath_physical: bearing worn -> +1 maintenance WU/day until overhauled
flywheel_instability.aftermath_human: residents in dimmed sections +stress; barks reference the brown-out

air_filtration_failure.trigger: power loss to scrubbers OR filter clog (storm)
air_filtration_failure.warning: fan pitch drops; section air chip ambers; 3-phase degrade window
air_filtration_failure.aftermath_human: exposed residents carry respiratory_exposure; evacuated sleepers +stress

storm_infiltration.trigger: Day-4 cinder storm vs seal placement & prep
storm_infiltration.warning: two-tier (D-022): free 1-phase telegraph always; monitored band = 2-day forecast + severity
storm_infiltration.aftermath_physical: prepped: cleanup only; unprepped: -2 materials damage + intake repair
storm_infiltration.aftermath_human: unprepped: +stress all; sealed-side choice remembered by the unprotected side's sleepers

structural_instability.trigger: storm load or clearing vibration on a strained bay
structural_instability.warning: dust fall + creak audio + Structure overlay flag; staged: strained->unstable->critical
structural_instability.aftermath_physical: reinforced bay is permanently safe; collapsed bay costs its contents (slice: never occupied-collapse without the full warning ladder)

water_contamination.trigger: post-storm cinder wash into the tank (east) or silt slug in the cistern intake (west)
water_contamination.warning: taste/odor report at the next meal window; water chip ambers; link named (storage vs purification)
responses: switch source (west: cistern; east: arcade bottled run)
water_contamination.aftermath_human: ill resident if ignored (illness course, 2 medicine); trust hit if the warning was dismissed

health_emergency.trigger: event-19 wound infected OR contamination illness
health_emergency.warning: fever banner at Graymorn; condition card names urgency + treatment need
health_emergency.pause_tier: modal_at_critical (auto-pause: a resident may die tier)
health_emergency.aftermath_physical: medicine spent; treatment occupies bed + carer WU
health_emergency.aftermath_human: treated resident remembers who sat with them; delayed treatment leaves a scar Mark (full game)

serious_injury.cause: escalated accident, unprepped storm, ignored minor
serious_injury.lasting: possible stiff-limb Mark if untreated 2+ days

respiratory_exposure.treatment: clean air + rest; 1 medicine if severe

exhaustion.restriction: must rest next shift; refuses hazardous work

highball._comment: The Redline system, named railway-native: HIGHBALL ORDER (the old all-clear/full-speed signal). One per day; usable <20s; no premium anything.
highball.effect: one works order gains +50% progress this phase OR one utility runs past rated capacity for one phase
highball.effect_model_status: the +50% labor benefit is NOT modeled in the slice simulation (the labor week is precomputed); the modeled benefit is the cascade bridge; net profitability vs the labor benefit is a first-playable revalidation gate (D-045)
highball.anti_spam: second use same day: unavailable; consecutive-day use of the same resident: refusal + stress; critical-fatigue or exhausted resident: refusal (hazard bar); 3+ uses/week: breakdown risk doubles (worn machinery persists)
highball.not_required_rule: no competent-path milestone may depend on it (asserted in tests)
